data.title: Bitcoin Holds, Wall Street Stalls as Oil Shock Revives Fed Hike Bets
data.description: Bitcoin is defending its golden zone support while the S&P 500 grinds inside its tightest range yet, both waiting on Friday's inflation report before the Fed's September 16 rate call.
